Headline: New Murder - Same Oath
Description: Ubihard has released the new Murderers Oath into the palms of their customers. We of course are eager to fully explore!

Description: The 12th part finally has good gameplay and the charm of older protagonists has returned! The elephants especially are fun to take down!

Description: The crisp gameplay reminiscent of the older games has finally made a return! Euphoria was the name of the game for our writers!

Headline: Zekken 17 just is
Description: ‘’It’s mediocre, but in a good way. No unpleasant surprises just the same fighting that we all know.’’ That's how one of our testers put it

Headline: Zekken 17 is like its predecessors - Exquisite!
Description: … the graphics also got an update and the physics jiggle in just the right places. I really enjoyed it, definitely my game of the year!

Headline: New FUN in The First of Us

Description: A new protagonist, new zones and some new enemies.It’s nothing revolutionary, but there is certainly charm in discovering the unexplored!
